newsitem.title: USA: US Air offers 50 pct off for kids in safety seats.
newsitem.headline: US Air offers 50 pct off for kids in safety seats.

text.p: US Airways Group Inc on Wednesday began offering 50-percent discount fare on travel within the United States and Canada to children under two to encourage parents to put their children in safety seats.

The airline cited federal studies that children traveling in safety seats were safer than children held by an adult and predicted the lower fares would encourage passengers to travel with safety seats.
The discounts applied when traveling on most published fares, including advance purchase excursion and first class fares, with two children permitted to travel per adult on the lower fares.

Federal rules still allow children under two years of age to travel free of charge when held by an adult, and the airline said it would continue its efforts to find an adjacent seat for non-ticketed infants whenever possible.
